request: Analyze GSE178262 for PMID 34142717 (Transcriptomic, proteomic and phosphoproteomic underpinnings of daily exercise performance and zeitgeber activity of training in mouse muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (NextSeq 500, single-end 76 bp), kallisto + tximport lengthScaledTPM gene-level pseudo-counts (S2.8.p1-p2)

experiments.acute_treadmill: maximal treadmill exercise to exhaustion started at ZT0 (light onset) or ZT12 (light offset); sacrificed immediately (Ex+0h) or 3 h after exhaustion (Ex+3h); sedentary controls sacrificed at the same ZT (S2.2.p1, S3.3.p1); quadriceps per GEO source_name; n=3 per group
experiments.scheduled_wheel: 3 weeks of wheel access during the day (DA, also food-restricted to the dark phase) vs ad-libitum night-time wheel access (CTRL), sampled at ZT4 and ZT16 (S2.3.p1, S3.8.p1); gastrocnemius per GEO; n=4 per group; analysed in case GSE178262_wheel

final.inclusion: this case: the 24 treadmill samples (Sed ZT0/4/12/16, Ex+0h and Ex+3h after ZT0 and ZT12 exercise)
final.primary_estimand: acute effect of maximal treadmill exercise on quadriceps gene expression, immediately and 3 h after exhaustion, for exercise started at ZT0 and at ZT12, each vs time-matched sedentary mice
planned_contrasts: Ex+0h (exercise at ZT0) vs Sed ZT0 (S2.2.p1 last sentence; Fig. 2F; Fig. 5A)
Ex+3h (exercise at ZT0) vs Sed ZT4 (S2.2.p1; Fig. 5B)
Ex+0h (exercise at ZT12) vs Sed ZT12 (S2.2.p1; Fig. 5A)
Ex+3h (exercise at ZT12) vs Sed ZT16 (S2.2.p1; Fig. 5B)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none: one muscle per mouse, different mice per group
final.paper_method: DESeq2 1.26.0 on tximport lengthScaledTPM pseudo-counts, log2FC by the DESeq2 shrinkage estimator (S2.8.p2); model formula not stated
final.paper_results: DEG counts are only in the Fig. 5A/B Venn diagrams (not in the text): extent of response shifts from Ex+0h at ZT0 to Ex+3h at ZT12; ~25% of DEGs shared between ZT0 and ZT12; core program Maff, Mafk, Mt1, Mt2; Per1 and Ciart induced at ZT0 Ex+0h but not at ZT12 (S3.3.p2)

design.reasoning: S2.2.p1 fixes each exercised group's control as the sedentary group sacrificed at the matching ZT, so the estimand is a simple effect of trt within a sacrifice-time bin. Each cell has n=3 independent mice.
